units: Normalized corpus WER percentages, rounded to two decimal places in the source report
decoding: greedy_batch; native streaming for Nemotron, offline TDT for Parakeet
selection: One candidate per LM family per checkpoint, selected on Gold development before final testing; maximum English regression 0.20 percentage points vs fresh baseline
limitations: Within-checkpoint comparisons; acoustic training histories differ.
Fresh controls belong to this campaign; do not substitute historical baselines.
Full ATCO2 has known Jacktol overlap; disjoint subset is not an exhaustive deduplication guarantee.
Historical evaluation sets have been examined repeatedly; LibriSpeech serves as a selection guardrail.
All selected LMs slightly regress on English despite passing the guardrail.
Statistical significance and serving performance were not measured.
Earlier beam-search LM results are a separate experiment.
